snippet.title: Heartspire – Official Trailer | Gothic Falling-Block Tower Defense
snippet.description:
The dead wood is climbing. You are the last Warden of the Heartspire.

Rune blocks fall around a gothic tower. Turn the tower, fill a whole ring, and the blast travels up the wall and strikes every creature climbing toward the Heart. Chain clears, charge your Wrath, and burn the wall clean when it all goes wrong.

• 50 levels across 5 worlds, each with its own boss
• The Vigil: endless waves where the bosses return
• A daily challenge, the same tower for every player
• Nightmare replays, Boss Rush and an original soundtrack

Free to try on iPhone and Android: the whole first world. Unlock the full game with one purchase. No ads, nothing else to buy.

Coming soon to the App Store, Google Play and Steam.
https://winchestergames.com/heartspire

A Winchester Games game.

#Heartspire #IndieGame #PuzzleGame
